title: Merry Making: Play, Build and Create With NVIDIA Technologies This Holiday Season
summary: Get into the game, bring a creative project to life or try building a robot with NVIDIA platforms.
body_markdown:
The elves don’t have to be the only ones busy in the workshop this holiday season. With the lights twinkling and the gift wrap out, it’s the perfect time to give someone — or yourself — a spark to take a hobby to the next level.


For some, that means diving into a new game. For others, it’s video editing or even building a robot.


NVIDIA technologies offer something for everyone on Santa’s list. Read on to unwrap the details.


## **Make Time for One More Game**


With the holiday break here, everyone can be online to score bragging rights or explore a world that’s only been seen in video game trailers.


For some players, an upgrade means a desktop that brings out the detail in every scene. For others, it’s a laptop they can take along when visiting family, or a way to play in the cloud on a device they already own.


The right setup depends on where and what to play:


- [GeForce RTX 50 Series](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/geforce/graphics-cards/50-series/) laptops and desktops power the action. Built on the NVIDIA Blackwell architecture, they feature fifth-generation Tensor Cores and fourth-generation RT Cores for AI-enhanced graphics, detailed ray-traced worlds and high frames-per-second gaming.


- [NVIDIA RTX Spark PCs](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/products/rtx-spark/) combine RTX graphics with NVIDIA’s full-stack AI platform on a single superchip, bringing decades of NVIDIA innovation to slim, premium laptops and compact desktops on the familiar Windows platform. One PC can handle every workflow, from accelerated creation and immersive gaming to powerful local AI — with a variety of designs and all-day battery life.


- See games in a new light with NVIDIA DLSS 5 technology, which boosts performance and enhances image quality. The newest feature, DLSS 3D-Guided Neural Rendering, infuses scenes with lifelike lighting and materials in supported games.


[Get a glimpse of NBA 2K27 with DLSS 5](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LHUzFnq70b8) .


- NVIDIA Reflex and G-SYNC make gameplay more responsive and fluid. Reflex reduces system latency in supported games, while


[G-SYNC displays](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/geforce/products/g-sync-monitors/) use variable refresh rates to deliver smooth, tear-free gaming.


- The


[GeForce NOW](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/geforce-now/) cloud gaming service enables playing top titles anywhere. Stream supported games on compatible laptops, TVs, handhelds and more. Connect to supported game stores to play owned PC games, with more than 4,500 titles available across the service.


## **Make Something Worth Sharing**


For creators with a project that’s been on the backburner, the right gift this season can be the push to finally make it happen. Maybe it’s holiday clips becoming a short film, a snowy scene coming together in 3D or a livestream that brings friends across time zones to the same virtual table. Creators can use NVIDIA systems — such as GeForce RTX 50 Series and RTX Spark devices — to keep up with the workflows, along with


[NVIDIA Studio tools](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/studio/) and technologies for AI acceleration.


Studio Drivers support video editing, 3D design and livestreaming. In supported applications, faster processing gives more room to experiment and refine.


## **Build a Robot That Thinks**


Every robot starts somewhere. This season, it could be under the tree.


Building a robot is an experiment in teaching a device to see or sense its surroundings. A first project might be as simple as using a camera to identify a candy cane or a gingerbread man, then moving on to an app that probes what the camera sees.


Testing brings new questions. Can the robot recognize the candy cane under twinkling lights? Can it tell a frosted gingerbread man from an unfrosted one? Each experiment leaves more to improve and explore.


The NVIDIA Jetson edge AI platform provides the hardware and software to build projects like these. It combines compact computers with the


[NVIDIA JetPack](https://developer.nvidia.com/embedded/jetpack) software development kit to help makers build robots, autonomous machines and intelligent devices.


A


[Jetson Developer Kit](https://marketplace.nvidia.com/robotics-edge/) is a gift to explore computer vision, generative AI and multimodal robot control, with the option to add cameras and sensors suited to various projects. AI runs directly on the device, processing information from its surroundings. When ready to take a prototype further, production systems powered by Jetson modules provide a path to deployment.


See how Microduck comes to life with


[NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano Super](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/autonomous-machines/embedded-systems/jetson-orin/nano-super-developer-kit/) , bringing together robot movement, visual understanding and natural-language interaction. With Hermes Agent and NVIDIA Cosmos, developers can explore how AI connects everyday requests with actions in the physical world.


Bring an SO-101 arm to life with NVIDIA Jetson Orin and explore agentic robotics.


Give OpenClaw a simple request, and watch it plan the steps, call NVIDIA tools and check the results.


[OpenShell](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/ai/openshell/) runs the agent securely in a sandbox, controlling its access to models and robot tools. Based on


[ASPIRE](https://research.nvidia.com/labs/gear/aspire/) skills, the system reuses lessons from past attempts to guide future tasks.


Build a robot companion that chats, moves and understands what it sees, with[NVIDIA](https://research.nvidia.com/labs/nemotron/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Bolt-E4B-4GB/)


[Nemotron 3.5 Bolt and Cosmos](https://research.nvidia.com/labs/nemotron/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Bolt-E4B-4GB/) open models running locally on Jetson Orin Nano 8GB.


For more advanced projects, explore vision language action models and world action models to enable increasingly sophisticated robotic behaviors — beyond simple perception and predefined actions toward understanding natural language instructions, reasoning, planning multistep tasks and interacting with the physical world.


Dive into setup guides and project tutorials in


[Jetson AI Lab](https://www.jetson-ai-lab.com/) .


Whether it’s a gaming upgrade, a creative project or a first robot, the right tools can open up new possibilities well beyond the holidays.


*Explore*[NVIDIA’s holiday lineup](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/holiday/) *for gamers, creators and makers.*
